import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from lib import *
em = Emb(base)
Cb=np.load('Cb.npy'); Cw=np.load('Cw.npy'); mu=np.load('mu.npy'); K=np.load('K.npy')
allv=np.arange(30522)
mpos=[3,15,35]
Mk = sum(em.h0(K,p) for p in mpos)/3
selfpos = [1,2,4,8,16,32,50,64,80]
Hk = np.stack([em.h0(K,p) for p in selfpos],1)  # [K,np,768]
Hall = {p: em.h0(allv,p)-mu for p in [2,20,50]}
for a,lam in [(1,0.01),(3,0.01),(3,0.05),(10,0.05),(3,0.2)]:
    C = Cb + a*Cw + lam*np.eye(768)
    U = np.linalg.solve(C, (Mk-mu).T).astype(np.float32)  # [768,K]
    U /= np.einsum('dk,kd->k',U,(Mk-mu))[None,:]
    selfr = np.einsum('kpd,dk->kp', Hk-mu, U)
    crossmax = np.full(len(K), -9.0)
    for p,Hp in Hall.items():
        for s in range(0,30522,5000):
            R = Hp[s:s+5000]@U  # [chunk,K]
            # mask self
            idx = np.where((K>=s)&(K<s+5000))[0]
            R[K[idx]-s, idx] = -9
            crossmax = np.maximum(crossmax, R.max(0))
    print(f'a={a} lam={lam} self: min {selfr.min():.3f} p1-mean {selfr[:,0].mean():.3f} p80-mean {selfr[:,-1].mean():.3f} 1pct {np.percentile(selfr.min(1),1):.3f} | cross max: median {np.median(crossmax):.3f} 90% {np.percentile(crossmax,90):.3f} 99% {np.percentile(crossmax,99):.3f} max {crossmax.max():.3f}')
